column1: # Host interfaces `tairitsu-web` references but `browser-glue` does not wire.
# `scripts/check_wit_surface.py --check` fails when a referenced interface is
# missing from both this list and the runtime registry, when an entry here goes
# stale (no longer referenced), or when an entry is already wired.
# These are real gaps, not conveniences: a guest that calls one of them has no
# host implementation and will fail at instantiation or trap on first use. The
# listed set is the honest inventory as of the single-source WIT cut; each line
# should disappear when the corresponding host support lands.
